description: Bundle FactLot facts (each must pass fact_validate) into a fact package a counterparty can verify: canonical JSON (RFC 8785) of every fact, an RFC 6962 Merkle tree over the facts, the source documents the facts cite with their sha256 where known, and a digest over all of it. Returns the unsigned package, its digest, and signing_message, the exact text to sign. FactLot never holds private keys: to sign, the holder signs signing_message with their own Ed25519 key on their own machine (factlot.sign_fact_package in Python, signFactPackage in @factlot/tools, or fact_package_sign in the local MCP server). Deterministic: no clock time is added (pass created_at), and the same facts always give the same digest.

created_at.description: When the package was made (ISO 8601 with offset). FactLot adds no clock time, so the same input always gives the same package.

documents.description: Source documents to describe beyond what the facts cite (a title, the file's sha256). Every document a fact cites is listed automatically.

document_id.description: The document's ID as the facts cite it.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact file, when known.

facts.description: The facts to package, in order: verified facts from the doc_* tools or any facts that pass fact_validate.

items.description: A FactLot fact (it must pass fact_validate).

name: fact_package_create
title: Create a fact package
